why: Both sides use the project's IsReflexive and IsWCG. A (all three theorems at universe 0) is stated for every real normed space; B, following the text's 'E a Banach space', only for complete ones. A => B is specialization. B => A has three parts. (i) A reflexive normed space is automatically complete (isometric to its bidual: LinearIsometryEquiv.ofSurjective on inclusionInDoubleDualLi), so B applies. (ii) For a separable normed space that is not complete, B says nothing, so this conjunct is re-proved outright by the project's short null-sequence argument; this is A's one genuine (harmless) extra generality. The helper span_closedBall_eq_top (the unit ball spans V) is not in B and is also re-proved by rescaling. On Banach spaces, the text's setting, A and B coincide.
overlap: 7 shared project theorems, all auto-generated _proof_ fields of the definitions IsReflexive and IsWCG that occur in the statement. No mathematical lemma is shared; the conjuncts re-proved directly use only Mathlib.
